messages.content: Explain what a Python dictionary is in plain language.
A Python dictionary stores information as key-value pairs. For example, {"name": "Sam", "age": 17} lets you look up a value by its key: person["name"] returns "Sam".
Rewrite this message so it sounds casual but respectful: I cannot attend the meeting today.
I can't make it to the meeting today, just wanted to let you know.
What should I include in a bug report?
Include a short title, what you expected, what actually happened, exact steps to reproduce it, screenshots or logs if available, and your device/browser or software version.
Explain the difference between RAM and storage.
RAM is the computer's short-term workspace used by running apps. Storage keeps files and apps when the computer is turned off. More RAM helps with multitasking; more storage gives you room for files.
Give me a simple checklist for testing an image upload feature.

1. Upload a small JPG. 2. Upload a PNG with transparency. 3. Try a large image near the size limit. 4. Try an unsupported file type. 5. Test on mobile. 6. Confirm previews, errors, and removal work. 7. Verify the server rejects oversized files safely.
